definitions.gloss: deluxe edition; luxury version; premium edition
definitions.explanation: A higher-quality, more elaborately produced version of a book, product, or service, typically featuring additional content, better materials, or special packaging at a higher price.

examples.japanese: {豪華版|ごうかばん}には{特典|とくてん}が{付|つ}く。
examples.english: The deluxe edition comes with bonuses.

examples.japanese: {限定|げんてい}{豪華版|ごうかばん}はすぐに{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The limited deluxe edition sold out immediately.

examples.japanese: {通常版|つうじょうばん}と{豪華版|ごうかばん}のどちらを{買|か}うか{迷|まよ}ったが、{結局|けっきょく}{豪華版|ごうかばん}にした。
examples.english: I was torn between the standard and deluxe editions, but ended up going with the deluxe.

notes:
Composed of {豪華|ごうか} (gorgeous/luxurious) + {版|ばん} (edition/version). Used for books, manga, DVDs, video games, and other products released in both standard and premium formats.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {限定|げんてい}{豪華版|ごうかばん}: limited deluxe edition
- {豪華版|ごうかばん}ボックス: deluxe box set
- {初回|しょかい}{豪華版|ごうかばん}: first-run deluxe edition
- {豪華版|ごうかばん}{特典|とくてん}: deluxe edition bonus items

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {通常版|つうじょうばん}: standard edition — the regular, lower-priced version
- {普及版|ふきゅうばん}: popular/affordable edition — emphasizes wide availability and lower price
- {特装版|とくそうばん}: special edition — focuses on unique packaging or binding
- {限定版|げんていばん}: limited edition — emphasizes scarcity rather than luxury
